name: Default
shortDescription: Retrieval-augmented generation engine that parses documents with layout analysis and OCR for grounded chat, search and agents, backed by Elasticsearch, MySQL, MinIO-compatible storage, Kvrocks and NATS.

alerts.message: Elasticsearch needs vm.max_map_count of at least 262144 on the server (sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144). Plan for at least 4 CPU cores, 16 GB RAM and 50 GB of disk.
Sign-up is open: register your account on first visit, then set ENABLE_REGISTER to 0 and redeploy. The Admin UI at /admin uses admin@ragflow.io with the password in ADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD.
Add a chat model and an embedding model under User settings > Model providers (API key of an external provider or a local model server) before creating datasets.
